disaster_break: birth/death/marriage records, IDs, immigration papers, leases, benefit letters, school records, or insurance papers lost
fraud_or_privacy_guardrail: minimum necessary data; legal safety review where status or abuse risk exists

disaster_break: lost or damaged phone, SIM, charger, power, or connectivity
fallback: phone/SIM replacement, charging access, voice/paper channels, community anchor access
fraud_or_privacy_guardrail: do not publish sensitive contact location; protect survivors fleeing abuse

disaster_break: SMS or app-based MFA impossible due to lost phone/account
fallback: temporary MFA exception, in-person proofing, trusted referee, recovery codes
fraud_or_privacy_guardrail: step-up proof proportional to risk; account takeover log

disaster_break: online-only application, upload, status, or appeal excludes affected person
fallback: paper, phone, field, in-person, library/community terminal, and assisted upload
fraud_or_privacy_guardrail: privacy screen; consent; correction route; language/disability access

disaster_break: lost email locks status notices and password reset
fallback: mail/phone/in-person notice route and updateable contact method
fraud_or_privacy_guardrail: verify before changing address; abuse-safe contact protocol
